brief: brief-fable-test-optimization.md: thirteen findings and four guards from a review of the test and CI strategy, after the owner's rule that tests cover application behaviour only. Unverified in the brief: 30 of 36 escapes caught by the queue; the cost of a database per test; the saving from moving roles checks or caching four films; whether one slow-database test subsumes another; the cost of a race run.
tradeoff: Given up: nothing a viewer or operator has. Left as they are, on no data that anyone is failing: a change's own integration failure is still found in the queue (about 45 minutes a cycle) until JS-175's count; the image's ffmpeg 8.1.3 is checked by the dogfood's use and JS-150's e2e play, not nightly, until JS-096; no race detector and no nightly seed soak; an ERROR on a fresh install's asset sweep, on a survived switchover and on a recovered job stays until JS-022; a stale compat/endpoints.yaml is found by a reader, not a gate.
entry: No new task and no priority moved. JS-175 criterion 5 regenerates the shard timings from three queue runs after the cleanup and keeps four shards; its table gains two columns that decide findings 1 and 11. JS-160 criterion 4 keeps a failed e2e scenario's viewer record, console and screenshot by scenario. JS-096 gains criterion 3: the ffmpeg-dependent transcode checks nightly under the published image's ffmpeg, never required. JS-022 criterion 2 settles that an ERROR line means a failure: an asset store nothing has been written to is empty, not an error (invariant 56 unchanged), with BL-067 and BL-167 promoted into it, and the gates fail on ERROR only after that. Backlog: BL-267 (a database per test), BL-268 (race detector, takes BL-179), BL-269 (roles harness), BL-270 (e2e start-up). Deferred to JS-175's count: integration shards on every pull request, fixed fault seeds, the slow-test review; no behaviour test leaves the required gate. Dropped: splitting docs/testing.md. Guards: the route-manifest comparison stays out with no lint, and DOMAINS invariant 20 says so; schema conformance and the compose-stack test stay; proof that a check can fail is made by hand and recorded, so JS-175 criterion 3, JS-160 criterion 1, JS-022 criterion 5, JS-093 criterion 7, JS-056's manifest checks and named mutants no longer ask for a committed test of the kit, docs or static files. One line joins spec-writer.md: assert what can be observed. Backlog items whose subject the cleanup deleted close. Reopens on: 3 or more of the 10 counted runs failing on a defect a pull-request integration run would have shown (a JS-097 criterion); a random seed failing a right build; a 40P01 after JS-158; the image's ffmpeg changing version or a dogfood playback fault that 6.1 passes (JS-096 criterion 3 moves ahead as JS-179); a race fatal on any deployment; an operator report of an ERROR on a healthy install (the asset-store case moves ahead as a brief); a recorded failure diagnosed twice.
serves: Owner, 2026-11-22: nothing outruns the product; tests cover application behaviour only. PRODUCT.md: 'Any film plays, and plays well'; 'every failure is reported with its reason, never silent'; 'Installing is boring'; 'A claim of working means a real client or a real store exercised it.' D-058: no nightly run, retry or workflow change ahead of JS-175's count.
